newsitem.title: USA: Veterinary Centers sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Veterinary Centers sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Veterinary Centers of America Inc said it expects its fourth quarter results to range from breakeven to a $0.04 per share loss, before a "restructuring and asset writedown charge."
That compares with a consensus estimate of a $0.05 per share profit, according to First Call.

The company said the charge will result from the restructuring that was started in the third quarter involving the integration of acquisitions. It said it expects to complete that process in the first quarter of 1997.
Last June, the company acquired Pet Practice Inc and announced plans to restructure its animal hospital and laboratory operations.
The comapny also said Monday that it expects to report fourth quarter revenues rose about 70 percent to about $52.1 million. But it said that same store sales fell about one percent.
